questions.question: What is the role of sports analytics in modern sports management?
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: Sports analytics involves the collection and interpretation of data related to athletes’
  • performance, team efficiency, fan engagement, and financial operations.
  • Performance Optimization: Helps coaches design training programs, track fatigue, and
  • improve tactics.
  • Injury Prevention: Identifies physical stress patterns to minimize injuries.
  • Talent Scouting: Uses metrics to assess potential players.
  • Strategic Decision-Making: Assists in game strategy and substitution decisions.
  • Fan Engagement & Marketing: Data insights enhance ticket sales, sponsorship, and fan
  • experience.
  • Example: IPL franchises use data analytics for player selection and in-game
  • decision-making.
questions.final_answer: decision-making

questions.question: Explain the impact of poor sports governance on public trust.
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: Poor sports governance—marked by corruption, lack of transparency, and
  • mismanagement—damages public confidence in sports organizations.
  • Loss of Credibility: Fans and sponsors withdraw support.
  • Reduced Participation: Athletes and youth lose motivation.
  • Financial Misuse: Misallocation of funds affects sports infrastructure.
  • Scandals & Match-Fixing: Create distrust in fair play.
  • Example: Scandals in organizations like FIFA and Indian cricket have led to governance
  • reforms.
questions.final_answer: reforms
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: How did cricket evolve as a national passion in India?
questions.solution_html:
• Answer
  • Introduced by the British during colonial rule.
  • Indian teams formed in the early 1900s; 1932 marked India’s first Test match.
  • Major turning points
  • 1983 World Cup victory ignited national pride.
  • Liberalization in the 1990s brought TV coverage and sponsorships.
  • IPL (2008 onwards) turned cricket into a mass entertainment industry.
  • Cricket now transcends class and region—seen as a unifying national identity.
questions.final_answer: Cricket now transcends class and region—seen as a unifying national identity
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Examine the importance of grassroots-level scouting in India.
questions.solution_html:
• Examine the importance of grassroots-level scouting in India.
  • Answer: Grassroots scouting identifies young talent early, ensuring sustainable athletic
  • development.
  • Talent Identification: Detects potential players at school and village levels.
  • Skill Development: Provides access to basic training, coaching, and facilities.
  • Inclusivity: Reaches rural and underprivileged athletes.
  • Long-term Benefits: Builds a strong talent pipeline for national teams.
  • Example: Programs like Khelo India and Mission XI Million support grassroots scouting.
questions.final_answer: Example: Programs like Khelo India and Mission XI Million support grassroots scouting

questions.question: Examine the challenges in implementing sports policies in India.
questions.solution_html:
• Examine the challenges in implementing sports policies in India.
  • Answer
  • Fragmented Governance: Overlapping roles between central and state authorities.
  • Inadequate Funding: Limited allocation for non-cricket sports.
  • Poor Infrastructure: Rural areas lack basic facilities.
  • Corruption & Bureaucracy: Hinders timely execution.
  • Lack of Accountability: Policies often fail due to poor monitoring.
  • Example: National Sports Policy (2001) and Khelo India initiatives aim to fix these gaps.
  • Suggestions: Strengthen governance, increase private participation, and ensure transparent
  • fund use.
questions.final_answer: fund use
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Analyze the challenges and opportunities for the ISL in establishing a sustainable and successful professional football league in India.
questions.solution_html:

  • successful professional football league in India.

  • Low grassroots participation.

  • Financial instability of smaller clubs.

  • Corporate investment and media coverage.

  • Expanding digital fan engagement.

questions.final_answer: Conclusion: With continued investment, ISL can become Asia’s leading football league

questions.solution_html:

• Critically examine whether India’s current sports infrastructure matches global standards.
  • Answer: Current Status
  • Major cities have world-class stadiums (e.g., Narendra Modi Stadium, Kalinga Stadium).
  • Rural areas still face lack of basic facilities, coaching, and maintenance.
  • Dependence on government funding delays projects.
  • Comparison with Global Standards
  • India lags in sports science, technology, and athlete support systems.
  • Limited integration of data analytics, recovery labs, and nutrition centers.
questions.final_answer: Limited integration of data analytics, recovery labs, and nutrition centers
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
